result.quote: the two divisions that would go off duty on the Sabbath are to guard the house of the LORD for the king.
result.reason: The key is supported, with “Yahweh” co-referring to “the LORD.” However, the broad verb “do” also permits the later action in verse 9: those going off duty came to Jehoiada. “Not serving” is also imprecise because the text says they are going off duty yet assigns them guard duty. Ask instead what they are assigned to guard.
